scripts.crawl:dry-run: pnpm --filter @everyday-policy/crawler... run build && pnpm --filter @everyday-policy/crawler run dry-run
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --parallel run dev
scripts.prepare: sh -c 'if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then git config core.hooksPath .githooks; fi'
